title: Neural Networks Reveal a Universal Bias in Conformal Correlators
summary: We propose that simple neural networks (NNs) trained on crossing symmetry can reconstruct conformal correlators restricted to a line to remarkable accuracy. The input is minimal: an external scaling dimension, a spectral gap, and the value of the correlator at a single point. We present evidence across a wide range of conformal theories and dimensions, for both four-point and thermal two-point functions.
